skill_name: What is the best way to construct a performance review?
workflow: The best way to construct a performance review is to assess the individual's performance in the areas most applicable to their job role. These areas should be linked to company objectives, so that there is a consistent need to evaluate and track progress against relevant goals. The review should also include feedback from the individual's peers and other relevant stakeholders, to paint a well-rounded picture of the employee's performance.
